note: Scripture source: the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, CC BY-SA 4.0), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv), all 66 books / 31,104 verses, with section headings (s/d/sp paras, keeping their verse markers), notes, k/xt/bdit spans and the IRV's 15 trailing cross-reference parentheses stripped. Translators looked up every quotation, cited or not, in that verse file and pasted the IRV wording.
Translated from the English as the deploy settles it (corrections.settled_chapter_body equals the shipped en fixture for all 18 chapters).

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND its block contains a 30-character run of that verse (or the whole verse, if shorter), compared with quotation marks, spaces and punctuation stripped. adapted/self_rendered rows and 70 unconfirmed verbatim claims (mostly short fragments and echoes) are self_rendered. Citation ranges over 3 verses keep only verifiable verses, else the first. 154 of 590 rows mined.

Conventions: curly quotation marks mirror the English; Wigglesworth's address to hearers/readers तुम (precedent the-way-to-god.hi, all-of-grace.hi; seven chapters were normalised from आप in a register pass), dialogue inside his stories keeps आप where a speaker addresses someone respectfully; 'Pentecostal' (the movement) पेन्टिकॉस्टल, Pentecost (the feast) पिन्तेकुस्त (IRV); baptism in the Holy Ghost पवित्र आत्मा का बपतिस्मा; tongues अन्य भाषा; the 'Tongues and Interpretation:' label अन्य भाषा और अर्थ:; chapter titles that are verses quote the IRV (Mark 11:22, John 5:6, Exod 15:26, Matt 8:17, Acts 5:20, 1 Cor 12:1) and the gift chapters take 1 Cor 12:8-10's IRV names.

IRV/KJV divergences flagged by the translators (render as Wigglesworth says, marked self_rendered): Mark 9:23 'If thou canst believe' (IRV critical text 'यदि तू कर सकता है!'); Luke 4:18 'to heal the brokenhearted' (absent from IRV); 1 John 4:3 'that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh' (taken from IRV 4:2's wording); Acts 3:6 'rise up and walk' (ch03 adds उठ, ch13 keeps the IRV); Acts 6:8 'full of faith' (IRV अनुग्रह); Acts 7:54 'cut to the heart'; Rom 10:17 'word of God' (IRV मसीह के वचन); 2 Pet 1:3 'called us to glory and virtue' (IRV के अनुसार); Ps 78:41 'limited the Holy One'.
Inner quotation marks the IRV carries (Mark 11:23, Rom 4:17, Ps 122:1, 1 Cor 14:21) were dropped or made parentheses where the English has none, so mark counts mirror the source.
